title: Breakdown of Perturbative Expansions and Exact Algebraic Absorption of Finite-Size Fluctuations in Statistical Mechanics
summary: In statistical mechanics, evaluating finite-size macroscopic fluctuations typically relies on Edgeworth expansions. However, these perturbative methods append additive polynomial corrections that break down in the large deviation regime, yielding unphysical negative probabilities. We propose a structural resolution: rather than relying on additive polynomials, we absorb finite-size skewness using a globally stable $q$-deformed framework.
